description: This Java source file defines the MakeFileParser class, which parses make files specific to Android build modules, extracting key-value information from make files and handling variable substitution.

classes.name: MakeFileParser
classes.description: A parser for Android make files that extracts module-specific key-value pairs and handles variable substitution within the make files.

methods.name: MakeFileParser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the parser with a specific make file.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the make file and populates the key-value map with extracted data.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves the value(s) associated with a given key from the parsed make file.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the parser object, mainly showing the current key-value mappings.
